answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, with transition mass discounted as it crosses uncertain edges. A Sybil cluster typically exposes a sparse external cut: its low conductance limits escape probability, so min-cut transitivity bounds cap the aggregate voting weight it can receive. A spiral of attestations cannot amplify beyond this bottleneck; each terrace of locally colluding nodes mostly returns an echo of the same evidence.
